name: Sacred Noire
original_name: セイクリッドノワール
source:
A girl who is often misunderstood because of her cool attitude and words, but she is actually a very passionate girl. To prepare for an unforeseen incident that may happen to the royal family, her ancestors has come to human world. When Tierna came to human world, she was deployed as the princess's bodyguard. However, her body is cursed, so her power and action are restricted.

「There is no reason to give my name to the evildoers!」
